name: Reversal
description: You unleash an all out attack that is stronger the less HP you have. Make a melee attack roll against a creature, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If you are below 50% of your maximum health, double the damage. If you are at 10% or below of your maximum health, triple the damage instead. The multiplier for this attack occurs before the multiplier for resistances or vulnerabilities.
